entities.name: Jorge López
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jorge Yabiel López Ramos is a Puerto Rican professional baseball pitcher for the Saraperos de Saltillo of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Milwaukee Brewers, Kansas City Royals, Baltimore Orioles, Minnesota Twins, Miami Marlins, New York Mets, Chicago Cubs, and Washington Nationals. He made his MLB debut in 2015 and was an All-Star in 2022.
